manual.windows.line2: {0}Framed glass windows allow some natural light to make its way into the factory, as to not rely on {1}lanterns{2} alone.{3}
manual.windows.line3: Frames made from Treated Wood are thicker, while Steel and Aluminium make for a thinner one.{0}
manual.windows.line4: Unlike normal glass panes, these windows can be placed horizontally in addition to vertically, to act as skylights!{0}
manual.windows.line5: {0}Made from laminated glass and {1}duroplast sheets{2} and encased in a sturdy frame of netherite, these windows are highly resistant to explosions even up to those of a Wither!
